summary: Correct, minimal fix: swaps only `top`/`bottom` grouping in the shared `_get_aligned_offsets` helper, resolving the reversed HPacker alignment while leaving `left`/`right` (used by VPacker), `center`, and `baseline` untouched. Matches the actual upstream resolution.

issues.description: Helper still lacks a brief comment explaining why `left`+`bottom` and `right`+`top` are grouped together (the dual VPacker/HPacker coordinate mapping that caused the original mistake), which would guard against a future re-reversal. Non-blocking nit.
